study.name: TORIVA-LUNG 301
study.label: TORIVA-LUNG 301
study.description: Simulated Phase 3 study of torivumab versus placebo in previously untreated advanced NSCLC with PD-L1 TPS >= 50%. Fictional sponsor and drug; synthetic data, educational use only.

versions.rationale: USDM v4 fragment GENERATED by tools/m11_to_usdm.py on the ICH M11-restructured protocol in study/m11/protocol/ (source TORIVA-LUNG 301 synopsis at 8534339d, restructured by tools/m11_restructure.py). Objectives, endpoints, estimands, analysis populations and biomedical concepts are carried over from the stage 0b regeneration (section-03, section-12-01, section-08-04-02). Arms, interventions, epochs, encounters, activities and the schedule of activities are generated from sections 01, 04 and 06, with D14 and D15 corrected and marked. Not in the source, therefore not here: eligibility criteria objects, visit-window timings, planned enrollment beyond the arm split.

studyDesigns.name: TORIVA-LUNG 301 Design
studyDesigns.label: Randomised double-blind parallel design
studyDesigns.description: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled parallel-group design. Protocol specifies 2:1 randomisation (300 torivumab : 150 placebo); the simulated data is 1:1 (225 : 225). The protocol synopsis records this discrepancy itself.

arms.name: Torivumab + Chemotherapy
arms.label: Torivumab 200 mg IV Q3W + carboplatin/pemetrexed
arms.description: Arm A (Active). Source §3.5: torivumab 200 mg IV infusion over 30 min, Q3W (Day 1 of each 21-day cycle), up to 35 cycles.
notes: D14: the source protocol describes torivumab monotherapy versus placebo (title, §1.4, §3.5, §5.1). SAP §13.2 and the built data (TRT01P) describe both arms on a carboplatin/pemetrexed backbone; the data is the ground truth, so the arm is named as the data names it. See study/gap-register.md.
D15: the source protocol states 2:1 randomisation (300:150). Its own header records the shipped data as generated 1:1 (225:225). The design here is 1:1. See study/gap-register.md.

arms.name: Placebo + Chemotherapy
arms.label: Placebo IV Q3W + carboplatin/pemetrexed
arms.description: Arm B (Control). Source §3.5: matching placebo IV infusion over 30 min, Q3W (Day 1 of each 21-day cycle), up to 35 cycles.
notes: D14: the source protocol describes torivumab monotherapy versus placebo (title, §1.4, §3.5, §5.1). SAP §13.2 and the built data (TRT01P) describe both arms on a carboplatin/pemetrexed backbone; the data is the ground truth, so the arm is named as the data names it. See study/gap-register.md.
D15: the source protocol states 2:1 randomisation (300:150). Its own header records the shipped data as generated 1:1 (225:225). The design here is 1:1. See study/gap-register.md.

population.name: ITT
population.label: Intent-to-Treat
population.description: All randomised subjects, analysed by randomised arm.

objectives.name: OBJ1
objectives.label: Primary objective - OS
objectives.text: To evaluate the effect of torivumab 200 mg Q3W versus placebo on Overall Survival (OS) in patients with previously untreated advanced or metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 TPS >= 50% and no EGFR or ALK genomic tumour aberrations.
objectives.description: Protocol synopsis section 2.1. The SAP restates this at section 2.1 with the null hypothesis: OS hazard ratio (torivumab / placebo) = 1.

endpoints.name: END-OS
endpoints.label: Overall Survival
endpoints.text: Time from randomisation to death from any cause. Subjects not known to have died at data cut-off are censored at the date last known alive.
endpoints.description: Protocol synopsis section 6, endpoint definitions. SAP section 4.1. Restructured into study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md.

objectives.name: OBJ-S1
objectives.label: Secondary objective S1 - PFS
objectives.text: To compare Progression-Free Survival (PFS) between the torivumab and placebo arms as assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR) per RECIST 1.1.
objectives.description: Protocol synopsis section 2.2, secondary objective 1. SAP section 2.2 S1 adds the null hypothesis PFS HR = 1.

endpoints.name: END-PFS
endpoints.label: Progression-Free Survival
endpoints.text: Time from randomisation to the first documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1 (BICR) or death from any cause, whichever occurs first. Subjects without progression or death are censored at the last adequate tumour assessment.
endpoints.description: Protocol synopsis section 6, endpoint definitions. SAP section 4.2. Restructured into study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md.

objectives.name: OBJ-S2
objectives.label: Secondary objective S2 - ORR
objectives.text: To compare the Objective Response Rate (ORR) (complete response [CR] + partial response [PR]) between treatment arms per RECIST 1.1 by BICR.
objectives.description: Protocol synopsis section 2.2, secondary objective 2. SAP section 2.2 S2 adds the null hypothesis ORR difference = 0.

endpoints.name: END-ORR
endpoints.label: Objective Response Rate
endpoints.text: Proportion of subjects with best overall response of CR or PR.
endpoints.description: Protocol synopsis section 6, endpoint definitions. SAP section 4.3. Restructured into study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md.

objectives.name: OBJ-S3
objectives.label: Secondary objective S3 - DoR
objectives.text: To evaluate the Duration of Response (DoR) in responders in each treatment arm.
objectives.description: Protocol synopsis section 2.2, secondary objective 3. SAP section 2.2 S3: no formal hypothesis test.

endpoints.name: END-DOR
endpoints.label: Duration of Response
endpoints.text: Time from first documented CR or PR to first documented disease progression or death from any cause, in responding subjects.
endpoints.description: Protocol synopsis section 6, endpoint definitions. SAP section 4.4. Restructured into study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md.

objectives.name: OBJ-S4
objectives.label: Secondary objective S4 - DCR
objectives.text: To compare the Disease Control Rate (DCR) (CR + PR + stable disease [SD]) between treatment arms.
objectives.description: Protocol synopsis section 2.2, secondary objective 4. SAP section 2.2 S4 adds the null hypothesis DCR difference = 0 and the SD >= 8 weeks requirement.

endpoints.name: END-DCR
endpoints.label: Disease Control Rate
endpoints.text: Proportion of subjects with best overall response of CR, PR, or SD maintained for at least 8 weeks.
endpoints.description: Protocol synopsis section 6, endpoint definitions. SAP section 4.5. Restructured into study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md.

objectives.name: OBJ-S5
objectives.label: Secondary objective S5 - Safety
objectives.text: To characterise the safety and tolerability of torivumab relative to placebo, including the incidence, severity, and management of adverse events (AEs), serious adverse events (SAEs), immune-related adverse events (irAEs), and adverse events of special interest (AESIs).
objectives.description: Protocol synopsis section 2.2, secondary objective 5. Descriptive; no formal hypothesis test. Safety assessments include laboratory evaluations, vital signs, ECG and ECOG performance status (protocol section 7).

endpoints.name: END-S5-LAB
endpoints.label: Safety - laboratory evaluations
endpoints.text: Laboratory evaluations: haematology and chemistry parameters, analysed as change from baseline and as shifts in reference-range indicator. Baseline is the last non-missing value on or before first dose (SAP section 12.3).
endpoints.description: The protocol names Safety as a key secondary endpoint and section 7.2 schedules laboratory assessments. The SAP does NOT define a laboratory analysis: ADLB appears only in the data-handling conventions (sections 12.2, 12.3 and 7), and the three safety estimands in section 13.7 are all adverse-event based. This endpoint is therefore authored from the protocol, not from the SAP, and that gap is recorded as discrepancy D11. Restructured into study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md.

endpoints.name: END-S5-VS
endpoints.label: Safety - vital signs
endpoints.text: Vital signs (BP, HR, temperature, weight, height) collected at screening, pre- and post-infusion on Day 1 of each cycle, end of treatment and 30-day safety follow-up, analysed as change from baseline. Baseline is the last non-missing value on or before first dose (SAP section 12.3).
endpoints.description: Second endpoint of the traverse, added 2026-09-19. The protocol schedules vital signs (section 7.2) and lists the measurements (data-domain table); it gives no collection or interpretation instructions and the SAP specifies no vital-signs analysis, as for laboratory evaluations (D11). Authored from the protocol, restructured into study/m11/protocol/section-08-04-02-vital-signs.md. No estimand targets this endpoint; E6 targets the laboratory endpoint.

estimands.name: E1
estimands.label: E1 - OS
estimands.description: Derived from study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md section 3.1.1, where ICH M11 requires the estimand attributes. The source protocol omitted them; SAP section 13 held them. See study/m11/protocol/README.md.
estimands.populationSummary: Stratified hazard ratio (torivumab / placebo) with 95% CI; strata = histology (squamous/non-squamous) x region (NA/EU/APAC). Supplementary KM medians and 12/18/24-month survival probabilities per arm.

intercurrentEvents.name: E1-IE
intercurrentEvents.label: Treatment policy
intercurrentEvents.description: Treatment discontinuation (any reason); initiation of subsequent anti-cancer therapy; palliative care. Death is the event, not an intercurrent event. Withdrawal of survival consent censors at withdrawal date.

estimands.name: E2
estimands.label: E2 - PFS
estimands.description: Derived from study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md section 3.2.1, where ICH M11 requires the estimand attributes. The source protocol omitted them; SAP section 13 held them. See study/m11/protocol/README.md.
estimands.populationSummary: Stratified hazard ratio with 95% CI; strata = histology x region.

intercurrentEvents.name: E2-IE
intercurrentEvents.label: Treatment policy for treatment discontinuation; Hypothetical for subsequent therapy, missed assessments and no post-baseline assessment
intercurrentEvents.description: Subsequent anti-cancer therapy censors at last adequate assessment before therapy. Two or more consecutive missed scheduled assessments censor at last adequate assessment before the gap. No post-baseline assessment censors at randomisation.
intercurrentEvents.text: Treatment policy for treatment discontinuation; Hypothetical for subsequent therapy, missed assessments and no post-baseline assessment

estimands.name: E3
estimands.label: E3 - ORR
estimands.description: Derived from study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md section 3.2.2, where ICH M11 requires the estimand attributes. The source protocol omitted them; SAP section 13 held them. See study/m11/protocol/README.md.
estimands.populationSummary: Stratified Mantel-Haenszel risk difference (torivumab - placebo) with 95% CI; strata = histology x region. Supplementary per-arm Clopper-Pearson exact 95% CI.

intercurrentEvents.name: E3-IE
intercurrentEvents.label: Composite
intercurrentEvents.description: No post-baseline assessment, treatment discontinuation before adequate assessment, subsequent anti-cancer therapy before adequate assessment, and death before first response assessment all count the subject as a non-responder.

estimands.name: E4
estimands.label: E4 - DOR
estimands.description: Derived from study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md section 3.2.3, where ICH M11 requires the estimand attributes. The source protocol omitted them; SAP section 13 held them. See study/m11/protocol/README.md.
estimands.populationSummary: Kaplan-Meier median per arm with 95% CI. No formal between-arm test; descriptive.

intercurrentEvents.name: E4-IE
intercurrentEvents.label: Hypothetical
intercurrentEvents.description: Subsequent anti-cancer therapy and two or more consecutive missed assessments censor as for PFS.

estimands.name: E5
estimands.label: E5 - DCR
estimands.description: Derived from study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md section 3.2.4, where ICH M11 requires the estimand attributes. The source protocol omitted them; SAP section 13 held them. See study/m11/protocol/README.md.
estimands.populationSummary: Stratified Mantel-Haenszel risk difference with 95% CI, as ORR.

estimands.name: E6
estimands.label: E6 - SAFETY
estimands.description: Derived from study/m11/protocol/section-03-objectives-endpoints.md section 3.2.5, where ICH M11 requires the estimand attributes. The source protocol omitted them; SAP section 13 held them. See study/m11/protocol/README.md.
estimands.populationSummary: Descriptive. n (%) per arm for incidence; events per 100 patient-years for exposure-adjusted rates; KM for irAE time-to-onset and time-to-resolution. NO LABORATORY SUMMARY IS SPECIFIED IN EITHER SOURCE DOCUMENT - see discrepancy D11.

intercurrentEvents.name: E6-IE
intercurrentEvents.label: Treatment policy for TEAE incidence; While-on-treatment for exposure-adjusted rates
intercurrentEvents.description: Treatment discontinuation; initiation of new anti-cancer therapy, after which AE collection ceases.
intercurrentEvents.text: Treatment policy for TEAE incidence; While-on-treatment for exposure-adjusted rates
